about: A single room on Main Street with shelves of things we would keep ourselves: ceramics, candles, linen, cards and the sort of gift you can buy on the way to the dinner.
Most of what is here comes from makers within a few hours' drive. If you like something and it is out, ask — a lot of it can be ordered in for the following week.
